vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: CVE-2025-4057 is currently PUBLISHED and the Red Hat CNA record describes credentials not regenerating between separate CRs. At the pre-fix tree bb645f7120c313854b5b1f652542e088b9ae18b1, environments.init() generates Defaults and GLOBAL_AMQ_CLUSTER_* only once per operator process, while ProcessCredentials copies those values into CR-specific broker credentials when the CR omits explicit values.

atomic_bic.evidence: 36aeb84b3c433d60dd53030199c08a2af20b9bea is the smallest public first-write of the reuse mechanism: it adds package-level Defaults plus init() generation and replaces per-CR admin credential generation with fallbacks to Defaults. Exact-symbol history identifies this first-write before later migration re-adds and the fix. cd47ded78f0c2f5d6892a05899d649c09963f4d9 later extends the already-existing mechanism to cluster credentials.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: The BIC has exactly one parent, 40b234bb802b901e37e92262b9fec6facf84df84. That parent has no environments.Defaults or Defaults declaration, and SetDefaults calls random.GenerateRandomString(8) separately for each empty CR User, Password, ClusterUser, and ClusterPassword field.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: 36aeb84b3c433d60dd53030199c08a2af20b9bea is an ordinary single-parent, non-merge public commit with no embedded member list to decompose. 9c0dae802b0ad21687d667bfa2f417434e55e313 deletes the old path, while bb1109d53c97d98458ff5de3de05d011bdafcb18 and 16f2dc95352db6be6d239ae55d63fd3ae232044e re-add migrated paths; these do not supersede the first-write BIC.

affected_and_fixed_release_membership.evidence: The BIC is an ancestor of 0.9.0 and v2.0.2. v2.0.2 still reads Defaults.AMQ_USER and GLOBAL_AMQ_CLUSTER_USER. Fix d3482fab6d0060794226c9e5a6fa67d209abc35a is not an ancestor of v2.0.2 but is an ancestor of v2.0.3, whose ProcessCredentials generates fresh random values. This matches the current CNA affected range 0 through versions below 2.0.3.

direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state.evidence: d3482fab6d0060794226c9e5a6fa67d209abc35a is the direct single-parent fix: it replaces all four process-global credential fallbacks in ProcessCredentials with random.GenerateRandomString(8) and deletes Defaults, GLOBAL_AMQ_CLUSTER_*, and environments.init().

bic_only_ai_attribution.evidence: AI attribution was checked only on BIC 36aeb84b3c433d60dd53030199c08a2af20b9bea. Its commit object names Roddie Kieley as both author and committer, and its one-line ENTMQBR-2846 message contains no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI-tool, bot, or similar marker. The real vulnerability is therefore NOT_AI under the protocol.

findings: The advisory is not withdrawn or rejected: CVE-2025-4057 remains PUBLISHED and Red Hat vendor data identifies affected products and fixed updates.
The primary record correctly distinguishes the admin-credential BIC from the later cluster-credential extension and from the 2021-2022 path migrations.
The primary introducer, parent, direct fix, release boundary, and BIC-only NOT_AI attribution all reproduce from the allowed advisory and clone evidence.
